description: Defines an interface IFileStore for abstracting virtual file storage operations, including file/directory info retrieval, creation, deletion, moving, copying, and stream access, along with extension methods for path normalization and combination.

classes.name: IFileStore
classes.description: An interface representing a generic abstraction over a virtual file store, providing methods for file and directory management and stream access.

classes.name: IFileStoreExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IFileStore, including path normalization and combination utilities.

methods.name: Combine
methods.description: Combines multiple path parts into a single path string using the file store's path delimiter semantics.

methods.name: NormalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes a path by converting backslashes to forward slashes and trimming leading/trailing slashes and spaces.

methods.name: NormalizeAndEscapePath
methods.description: Normalizes a path and escapes each segment for URI compatibility.
